overlays.title: Smart-Clearance
overlays.text: Near-expiry stock, routed by AI agents. One yes from a person.
overlays.sub: Munchly Foods · the Mango Drink batch · Hyderabad

overlays.text: Munchly Foods makes it. By the time a batch reaches a distributor's godown, the clock on its best-before is already running.
The batch
Lakshmi Agencies holds **2,000 packs** of Mango Drink 200 ml, batch MF-2410-118, with **22 days** to best-before.
overlays.label: Begum Bazaar godown · Hyderabad

overlays.text: Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart stop taking a pack this close to its date: **three gates, all crossed**. Destroying it would cost **₹23,059**.
overlays.label: The quick-commerce gates

overlays.text: A SaaS, run by agents
Smart-Clearance is software as a service: Munchly's workspace is one of many, set up and watched by the platform's staff in the console.
overlays.label: Smart-Clearance · the staff console

overlays.text: Every client's batches in flight, the agents at work on each stop, what was recovered, and the food kept out of landfill, day by day.
overlays.label: The console · Overview

overlays.text: **Ten agents on Gemini** work a batch: Watcher, Vision, Valuer, Router, Lister, Negotiator, Outreach, Donation, Paperwork and Impact. A person says yes once.
overlays.label: Munchly Foods · Agents

overlays.text: Each client's own rules: the quick-commerce gates, the exits and their prices, the kirana scheme, the expiry policy.
overlays.label: Munchly Foods · Channels & rules

overlays.text: Detect
Every morning the Watcher checks every batch at every distributor against sell-through and the gates.
overlays.label: 09:00 · Pune

overlays.text: **1,608 packs** will not sell before 24 Oct. Priya is told on her phone, in the words she reads.
overlays.label: The Watcher

overlays.title: Mango Drink 200 ml · Hyderabad
overlays.body: Priya ji, Hyderabad godown mein Mango Drink 200ml (batch MF-2410-118) ki 1,580 units 24 Oct se pehle nahi bikengi. Q-commerce block hai. Route dekhne ke liye tap karein.

overlays.text: The batch has its own page: flagged, at risk, and what each agent does next. Nothing is hidden from the operator.
overlays.label: The batch's page

overlays.text: Verify
One photo of the carton's label is all Vision asks of the distributor. Bas ek photo.
overlays.label: Vision

overlays.title: Ek photo chahiye
overlays.body: Lakshmi Agencies, Mango Drink 200ml ka ek carton ka label photo bhej dein (batch MF-2410-118). Bas ek photo, baaki hum kar lenge.

overlays.text: Her Today card asks for it: take a photo, or upload one.
overlays.label: Lakshmi Agencies · Today

overlays.text: Vision reads the batch, MFG, best-before and MRP from the label and matches them to the DMS export. The batch is real, and it is this one.
overlays.label: Vision · Gemini

overlays.text: Value, decide, approve
The Valuer prices five exits. The Router splits the batch: **1,372** to the kiranas, **150** to the staff sale, **86** to Feeding India. Net **₹16,888**, **₹22,258** better than the bin.
overlays.label: Valuer · Router

overlays.title: Plan ready · MF-2410-118
overlays.body: Plan for MF-2410-118: 1,372 units kirana (₹12), 150 units staff sale (₹8), 86 units food bank (₹0). Net ₹16,888, ₹22,258 better than write-off. GST ITC ₹837 safe. Tap to review and approve.

overlays.text: Priya says yes once, from her phone. The approval is logged with who, when and device.
overlays.label: One yes

overlays.text: The distributor is told the plan, with a Pause. The agents set off: Outreach to the shops, Donation to the food bank, the staff sale opened.
overlays.label: Execution

overlays.title: Plan approved · Mango Drink
overlays.body: Lakshmi Agencies, Munchly ne MF-2410-118 ka plan approve kiya: 1,372 packets aapke kiranas ko scheme par, 150 godown ki staff sale mein, 86 food bank ko. Kuch rokna ho to app mein Pause dabayein.

overlays.text: The kiranas
58 shops in the old city get the offer in their own language: **buy 10, get 2 free**, for 48 hours.
overlays.label: Outreach · in Hindi

overlays.to: To Sri Lakshmi Ganapathi Kirana · Begum Bazaar
overlays.title: आज का खास ऑफर
overlays.body: नमस्ते Sri Lakshmi Ganapathi Kirana! Munchly Mango Drink 200ml पर आज खास ऑफर: 10 पैकेट लो, 2 मुफ़्त. Best before 24 Oct 2026. सिर्फ़ 48 घंटे. ऑर्डर के लिए टैप करें — Lakshmi Agencies

overlays.text: In her app: the scheme, her cap (what she sells in two weeks, times four) and her margin. She orders in a tap.
overlays.label: Sri Lakshmi Ganapathi Kirana · the offer

overlays.text: **₹20 MRP packs at ₹12 effective**: with 2 free in every 12, **₹8 a pack** stays with the shop. Fresh stock at a scheme price, with no haggling.
overlays.label: What a kirana gains

overlays.text: A fair price for the shop, a fair price for the customer, and a brand that keeps its shelf.
overlays.label: The shop

overlays.text: **52 shops order 1,372 packets** inside the window, each under its cap. Every order is a line in the audit trail.
overlays.label: Execution

overlays.text: The staff sale
150 packs for the godown's own staff at ₹8, paid on UPI at the gate, recorded once by the distributor.
overlays.label: Begum Bazaar godown · dusk

overlays.title: Staff sale · Mango Drink
overlays.body: 150 packs of Mango Drink for your staff at ₹8 a pack, at Begum Bazaar godown. Record what sold when the sale is over.

overlays.text: Recorded: 150 of 150 sold. What sold is what counts; nothing is assumed.
overlays.label: Lakshmi Agencies · Today

overlays.text: The food bank
Packs with 15 or more days left go to a food bank, with the FSSAI surplus-food checklist drafted for them.
overlays.label: Donation

overlays.title: Pickup request · Mango Drink
overlays.body: 86 packs of Mango Drink, 21 days left, with the FSSAI checklist. Pickup from Begum Bazaar godown?

overlays.text: Feeding India collects 86 packs at the godown: **86 meals** served, instead of 86 packs in a landfill.
overlays.label: Feeding India · Hyderabad

overlays.text: Feeding India issues its own donation receipt, numbered in its own series, with its PDF. Munchly and the distributor each keep a copy.
overlays.label: Meera · Pickups

overlays.title: Feeding India confirmed
overlays.body: 86 packs of Mango Drink, pickup Tuesday 10:00 from Begum Bazaar godown.

overlays.text: Delivery and the papers
The Saturday round delivers the scheme to every shop that ordered.
overlays.label: Saturday · the van round

overlays.title: Van route for Tuesday
overlays.body: Van route for Tuesday updated: 52 kiranas, 1,372 packets.

overlays.text: Her deliveries, batch by batch: the round to the shops, the staff sale, the food bank's pickup.
overlays.label: Lakshmi Agencies · Deliveries

overlays.text: Paperwork drafts the pack and lays each paper out as a PDF: the credit note, the GST memo, the FSSAI checklist, the receipt.
overlays.label: Paperwork

overlays.title: Document pack ready · MF-2410-118
overlays.body: Papers ready for MF-2410-118: price-support credit note, GST memo. Nothing to chase.

overlays.text: The credit note: Munchly's price support to Lakshmi Agencies, so the distributor **ends whole** on the batch. A financial note, with no GST adjustment.
overlays.label: Price-support credit note

overlays.text: The GST memo: input credit **kept on every pack sold**, reversed only on the 86 given away. **₹837 of credit stays with Munchly**.
overlays.label: GST ITC memo · s.17(5)(h)

overlays.text: The FSSAI checklist for the donation, drafted from the batch's own dates and the food bank's rules.
overlays.label: FSSAI surplus-food checklist

overlays.text: The ledger
On expiry day nothing is left at the godown. Impact posts the ledger, and the batch is cleared.
overlays.label: Expiry day · Impact

overlays.title: Batch closed · 0 cartons destroyed
overlays.body: ₹16,888 recovered, ₹837 GST credit kept, 345.7 kg kept out of landfill.

overlays.text: **₹16,888 recovered** on a batch that was headed for a **₹23,059** write-off.
overlays.label: Munchly Foods · Pune

overlays.text: One ledger, three readings. Money: what was recovered against the would-be write-off, every batch a segment, by quarter and by year.
overlays.label: Ledger · Money

overlays.text: GST: input credit kept and reversed under s.17(5)(h), the invoices and the credit notes, exported as the CA receives them.
overlays.label: Ledger · GST

overlays.text: Impact: **346 kg** of food kept out of landfill, **864 kg** of CO₂e avoided, **86 meals**, and BRSR Principle 6's food-waste row with its evidence.
overlays.label: Ledger · Impact

overlays.text: The batch's own BRSR line and its evidence: 52 kirana order logs, CN/0117, the FSSAI checklist, receipt FI/HYD/26-27/0417.
overlays.label: The batch's BRSR line

overlays.text: And in the console, across every client: food kept out of landfill by day, and what was destroyed, on one scale.
overlays.label: The console

overlays.text: Everyone ends whole
The brand recovers. The distributor ends whole. The kiranas earn. The food bank serves.
overlays.label: Hyderabad

and the receipt that proves it
